article_notes: Shelter survey of 122 clinically healthy dogs in Thailand (B. vogeli, E. canis, A. platys by PCR). Haematology compared between uninfected, single, double and triple infections; there are no clinical severity or outcome groups (dogs had no clinical signs), so co-infection is compared only against haematological values, not against a severity definition. Comparisons involving the uninfected group counted as infected vs healthy (13 haematology variables).
